Men's hair in Kuantan

Cuts, texture and colour for men, with the same care.

Book on WhatsApp

We cut and colour men's hair, and we do the men's foil perm (男士锡纸烫) and a natural texture perm for hair that lies flat.

Tell us how you style your hair in the morning and how much time you want to spend on it. We plan the cut or perm around that.

Questions we are often asked

Do you do men's perms?

Yes. We do the men's foil perm and a natural texture perm. WhatsApp us a photo and the look you want.

Can men book a colour too?

Yes. Men's colour is part of our men's hair work. Talk it through with us on WhatsApp first.
